title: Sell Mineral Rights in McGovern, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in McGovern, PA | Washington County
metaDescription: Small Washington County community, big Marcellus activity. We buy mineral and royalty interests around McGovern, PA directly, no broker, no listing.
heroLead: McGovern is a small crossroads community in Washington County, easy to miss on a map but sitting inside one of the busiest Marcellus development corridors in the state.
intro: There isn't much to McGovern itself, but the surrounding farmland has been part of Washington County's Marcellus development story for well over a decade. If your family held ground here, chances are it got pooled into a horizontal unit at some point, even if the actual well pad sits a mile or more away.

We buy mineral and royalty interests tied to McGovern and the surrounding townships directly. We're the buyer, not a middleman, and we'll walk you through exactly how we arrived at any number we offer.

sections.heading: Small Community, Large Drilling Units
paragraphs: Modern Marcellus laterals often run well past a mile, which means a horizontal unit can pull in dozens of small legacy tracts around a place like McGovern without a single well pad sitting anywhere near the property itself. That's a source of real confusion for owners who assume no drilling means no interest.

If you've gotten a division order or royalty check referencing a unit you don't recognize by name, that's usually exactly what happened, your acreage got included in a pooled unit named for the well pad location, not your parcel.

sections.heading: Confirming What You Actually Own
paragraphs: We start by pulling your deed and any related conveyances from the Washington County Recorder of Deeds in the county seat. Rural Washington County tracts, especially smaller ones near McGovern, sometimes changed hands informally within families over the years without every transfer getting properly recorded, so title work here takes real attention.
Once we've confirmed the chain of title, we compare it against the operator's division order to make sure the decimal interest you're being paid matches what your deed actually supports.

sections.heading: Reading a Pooled-Unit Royalty Statement
paragraphs: Royalty statements from pooled units can look intimidating, with unit percentages, allocated production, and deduction line items all stacked together. We'll go through yours with you line by line so you understand what you're actually being paid and why, before we ever discuss a purchase price.

faqs.question: There's no well pad on my land near McGovern. Can I still have mineral rights worth selling?
faqs.answer: Yes. Horizontal units regularly pull in acreage far from the actual pad. If your land was pooled into an active unit, your interest can have real value even without a wellhead on the property.

faqs.question: My family never formally recorded an old transfer. Is that a problem?
faqs.answer: It can slow things down, but it's a common issue in this area and one we've worked through before. We'll tell you exactly what's needed to clean up title.

faqs.question: What if I don't have my division order handy?
faqs.answer: We can often locate it through the operator once we know which unit your acreage falls in, so missing paperwork isn't a dead end.
